 Print Vijay Sethupathi ’s latest film, 'Baththa', is all set for an OTT release very soon. The Tamil drama directed by Balaji Tharaneetharan features a lot of comedy, emotions, and human relations. Despite the positive reviews, 'Baththa' couldn’t fare well commercially after its release. An OTT release will definitely bring it in front of many more viewers. 'Baththa' OTT release date announced
 The makers have confirmed that 'Baththa' will begin streaming on Netflix from October 29, 2026. The film, which arrived in theatres on October 1, will make its digital debut around four weeks after its theatrical release. Along with the original Tamil version, the movie will also be available in Telugu, Hindi, Kannada and Malayalam. The five-language release could help the film reach audiences across different regions. It also gives Telugu-speaking viewers an opportunity to watch Vijay Sethupathi’s performance in their preferred language. The OTT release comes as the film’s theatrical run has drawn to a close, making its digital performance worth watching. Watch Vijay Sethupathi plays double role for the first time Vijay Sethupathi plays a gangster in this emotional drama
 The film follows a young boy, played by Sai Prithviraj, who accidentally locks a feared gangster, portrayed by Vijay Sethupathi, inside a school toilet. When the boy returns to let him out, fear stops him from completing the task. The unique situation acts as the foundation for the story that blends humor with emotion. ‘Baththa’ also explores issues such as masculinity, fear, patriarchy, redemption, and human relationships. Its emotional story has drawn comparisons with the Tamil film 'Meiyazhagan.' Director Balaji Tharaneetharan shows people's hidden fears and feelings through the bond between the two main characters. About 'Baththa' cast
 Alongside Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Prithviraj, the film features Lijomol Jose, Santhy Balachandran, Ajay Ghosh and Arjun Chidambaram, among others. Sai Abhyankkar composed the music, with the song ‘Magale’ becoming popular on social media through short videos and reels. Despite favourable responses to its direction, performances and music, 'Baththa' reportedly collected around Rs 33 crore gross at the box office, according to Sacnilk. Its digital release now offers the film a fresh opportunity to find a wider audience, allowing viewers to discover its blend of humour and emotion from home.
